# Support

`react-native-scroll-interop` is currently an Android-first public alpha.

Before opening an issue, reproduce on a supported version from the compatibility matrix in [`README.md`](../README.md) when possible.

For native-scroll behavior reports, include the package version, React Native version, Expo SDK if applicable, `react-native-screens` version if applicable, Android API level, device/emulator and ABI, affected phase, deterministic reproduction, and relevant native logs.

For visual-motion reports, confirm Android animation scales are enabled. Instrumentation frameworks may temporarily disable animator/transition/window animation scales and make a valid native settle appear instantaneous.

Compatibility claims are expanded only after a fresh package/build/runtime gate passes.
